design: Exhaustive signed source b and proposed resolvent y, m=1..6; SAT sources and UNSAT controls
exact_theorem: Fixed grammar: step RES(C_b,not p,p) => E_y legal iff b=y. Deterministic one-pass working state count at least 2^m; p-pass tradeoff p(s+O(1))=Omega(m); indexed read-only check uses O(log M) working bits and polynomial charged rereads.
resources: M = full source+claim evidence bits, not CNF alone; no host RSS bound. Construction/semantic proof production excluded and fully charged if used by SAT solver.
limitations: Finite tests do not prove streaming space asymptotics. Established Haken bound is ordinary Resolution only. P versus NP OPEN.
